obligations.obligation: Member bookings, staff maintenance holds and daily readiness
obligations.assessment: Complete domain and staff/member view proposals; fault state differs from reservation state.

obligations.obligation: Tools, conditional qualified supervision and shared extraction
obligations.assessment: Compound allocation, scarce supervisor capacity and extractor contention modeled; capacities, task matrix and qualifications remain legitimate owner facts.

obligations.obligation: Fault after accepted booking, readable conflict and preserved change reason
obligations.assessment: Protected unavailability/affected list, explicit staff action, old/new state, actor/time/reason and notifications; no silent booking or hold loss.

obligations.obligation: Simultaneous booking and edits, atomic allocation
obligations.assessment: Authoritative transactional checks, exclusive-resource invariants and no partial bundle; quantity-pool enforcement is a separate condition. Software execution is not required for this proposal.

obligations.obligation: Recurring maintenance, exceptions, horizon and time
obligations.assessment: Finite/visible rules, occurrence/series edits and timezone/DST checks. Control explicitly aligns safe projection to booking lead time; treatment separates horizon from rule/end date but leaves a thinner horizon invariant.
Lifecycle transitions and future-capacity release retain original explanation; exact no-show/cancellation/displacement policies remain open.

obligations.obligation: Internet down, local workstation, justified browser and approximately 100 members
obligations.assessment: WAN loss distinguished from host/LAN/power loss; local authority, unsubmitted/provisional requests, blocked disconnected confirmation and recovery reconciliation.
Authority, notice, priority, fairness and safe in-use handling remain owner decisions; no automatic policy selected.

obligations.obligation: Calendar is not capacity enforcement; member cannot erase holds
obligations.assessment: Explicit authoritative service and protected staff hold invariant. Calendar feeds are convenience/interchange, not transactional enforcement.

obligations.obligation: No payments, identity documents or mandatory hosted accounts
obligations.assessment: Preserved throughout; local minimal identity/account/contact decisions remain open.
Purpose-limited staff history/export, minimal fields, member privacy and retention decisions. No need to invent a jurisdiction or retention duration.

obligations.obligation: Feasible local/shared alternatives, useful mechanism research
obligations.assessment: SQLite/local service, PostgreSQL/LAN, MRBS and LibreBooking discussed with operating/support/version conditions; assess the candidate comparison semantically, not by citations.
Synthetic fit checks, staff shadow/pilot and gated member route; meaningful failure/privacy/restore oracles, proposed rather than executed.

obligations.obligation: Planning proposal; no real installation/data or future execution required
obligations.assessment: Both finals are proposals and do not assert application validation passed. Static upstream test inspection is correctly distinct from execution.

obligations.obligation: Complete exact revealed-plan dispositions and critic preservation
obligations.assessment: Every substantive plan clause assessed and every critic finding traced; original brief/plan time envelope retained as mechanics, not a product requirement.

critic_dispositions.review: Every material change records supplied reason/code; staff safety reasons required and owner free-text policy remains open.

Delete/notification test is correctly limited; immutable audit history remains unproved, not declared absent.

limitations: COMPLETE denotes finite review of every assigned substantive document, axis, obligation and consequential source family, not exhaustive repository, source, runtime or future-release correctness.
No product was installed and no software validation was required or executed by this evaluator. Proposed tests are not passing results.
Real capacity, supervision, urgent displacement, identity/contact scope and retention remain legitimate unknown user facts.
Candidate source lookup/execution assertions cannot be independently reconstructed from the frozen indexes; native transport linkage and billing remain unknown.
MRBS transaction creation does not prove parallel-request isolation, required resource selection or unified later booking lifecycle.

Treatment’s horizon language is thinner than a full materialization/booking-horizon invariant, but the proposal does not promise bookings beyond projected maintenance; this is a nonmaterial planning limit, not proof of a runtime hole.
outside_requested_delivery: Future deployment, actual software concurrency/outage/restore execution, universal source correctness, unavailable private telemetry
